description: Ask ChatGPT about the events your Checkin account can access—without exporting reports. Find events, attendees, contacts, and orders; monitor ticket sales and check-ins; review payment status and revenue; and compare event performance. All tools are read-only and respect your existing Checkin account permissions.

defaultPrompt: Find my next event and summarize sales, attendance, check-in, capacity, and anything that needs attention.
Compare this year's event with last year's on orders, tickets sold, revenue, check-in, and no-shows.
For my latest event, analyze weekly sales, ticket types, discounts, and outstanding balances.
